title: Missed-Visit Fee Cap by Membership Tenure — Comfort Club
content:
Long-standing Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements members have their missed-visit fee capped. Tenure is the number of whole calendar months from the agreement's enrolled date to the date of handling.

## Tenure cap rule
| Months since the agreement was first enrolled | Cap on the missed-visit fee |
|---|---|
| 84 or more (the long-tenure months) | 30.00 USD (the long-tenure cap) |
| 48 or more but fewer than 84 (the mid-tenure months) | 40.00 USD (the mid-tenure cap) |
| Fewer than 48 | no cap under this rule |


## Cases (hypothetical fee before the cap of 60.00)
- Enrolled 90 months ago: capped at 30.00.
- Enrolled 60 months ago: capped at 40.00.
- Enrolled 84 months ago exactly: the long-tenure cap of 30.00 applies.
- Enrolled 30 months ago: no cap; 60.00 stands.

A fee already below the cap is unaffected: a 25.00 fee on an agreement enrolled 100 months ago stays 25.00.
